''See also: [[Luminian Order Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Luminian]] [[Order]] is one of the four [[Independent Guilds]] of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. Founded by a woman named [[Loreli]], the organization is centered around the worship of the [[Unknown God]] and follows teachings that emphasize the virtue of the Emperor. The [[Order]]'s headquarters, known as [[Hightower]], is a fortified location in the capital region that possesses a protective [[aura]] of peace and tranquility developed over centuries. The group is currently led by [[Jameson Allbright]], who has been working to rebuild communication networks and coordinate resources globally in response to increased Elder activity. The [[Order]] is composed of several distinct roles. [[Pilgrims]] are recognizable by their white clothing and silver medallions, often serving in roles related to healing and medical assistance. While some [[Pilgrims]] possess the [[Soulbound]] ability to heal, they must undergo years of service and demonstrate proficiency in alchemy and medicine before being granted such status. Additionally, the [[Order]] maintains [[Luminian Knights]], who wear silver armor decorated with the [[White Sun]] crest—the organization's symbol. Historically, the Luminian{{!}}Luminians have been known for leading humanity into war and were once characterized by their intense hatred of the [[Elders]]. In more recent times, they have shifted toward preaching peace and providing security for the [[Independent Guilds]]. Despite this shift, they remain a disciplined and organized force that has faced significant losses in recent conflicts, making it difficult to replace their specialized knights.}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|After previously leading humanity into conflict, the [[Luminian]] [[Order]] transitioned into a merciful clerical organization dedicated to preaching peace. The group maintains specialized smiths who have undergone training by the [[Alchemist's Guild]]. Despite this connection, the [[Order]] opposes the Authority{{!}}authority of the [[Guilds]] to select a new Emperor. During the events surrounding [[Shera]], many members of the order demanded her immediate execution.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Luminian Order]] began preaching peace after once leading humanity to war.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 1</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Luminian Order]] has smiths trained by the [[Alchemist's Guild]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c6">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Luminian Order]] does not support the right of the [[Guilds]] to choose a new Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The [[Luminian Order]] is a merciful clerical order.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Many members of the [[Luminian Order]] called for [[Shera]]'s immediate execution.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c17">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As one of the four [[Independent Guilds]], the [[Luminian]] [[Order]] operates as a disciplined and organized group composed of [[Pilgrims]] and knights clad in silver. Headquartered within the greater Capital area, the organization maintains strict regulations regarding which [[Pilgrims]] are permitted to wield the full power of a [[Soulbound]]. While providing support to the [[Independents]], the [[Order]] also pursues its own justice, as evidenced by the fact that Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel is a wanted fugitive of the group.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Luminian Order]] is one of the four [[Independent Guilds]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Luminian Order]] is a disciplined and organized group consisting of knights in silver and [[Pilgrims]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c6">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Luminian Order]] is supporting the [[Independents]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Luminian Order]] has strict regulations on which [[Pilgrims]] can possess the full power of a [[Soulbound]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel is a wanted fugitive of the [[Luminian Order]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Luminian Order]]'s headquarters is in the greater Capital area.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Luminian]] [[Order]] serves as the caretakers for a madwoman touched by an Elder and provides open security on behalf of the [[Independent Guilds]]. This organization, which co-created the sealing boxes, operates out of a headquarters characterized by an [[aura]] of peace and tranquility. Founded by [[Loreli]], the first of their kind, the [[Order]] finds itself stretched thin in the aftermath of recent fighting. During this period of strain, [[Darius Allbright]] assists the group in coordinating the evacuation of the city.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Luminian Order]] is the group caring for an [[Elder-touched madwoman]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Luminian Order]] is providing open security on behalf of the [[Independent Guilds]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c4">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The sealing boxes were created in conjunction with the [[Luminian Order]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The headquarters of the [[Luminian Order]] carries an [[aura]] of peace and tranquility.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c12">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli]] is the first of the [[Luminian Order]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Luminian Order]] is stretched thin following the fighting.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Darius Allbright]] helps the [[Luminian Order]] coordinate city evacuation.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
